MSP Committee Lacks Report After Four Years, Funds Spent

A committee formed four years ago to address the issue of Minimum Support Price (MSP) has not yet produced a report. Despite the lack of a final report, the committee has reportedly spent approximately Rs 53 to Rs 54 lakh. This development comes after a promise of transparency related to MSP.
